definitions.explanation: Indicates the minimum amount, degree, or extent; even if nothing else.

examples.japanese: {少|すく}なくとも{一時間|いちじかん}はかかる。
examples.english: It will take at least one hour.

examples.japanese: {少|すく}なくとも{三回|さんかい}は{読|よ}んだほうがいい。
examples.english: You should read it at least three times.

examples.japanese: {少|すく}なくとも{私|わたし}はそう{思|おも}う。
examples.notes: Used to express personal opinion as a minimum assertion

notes:
FORMATION: From {少|すく}ない (few, little) in its く-form + とも (even if).

WRITING: Often written in hiragana as すくなくとも.

POSITION: Usually appears at the beginning of a clause or before the element it modifies.

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・せめて - at least (with nuance of hoping for minimum)
・{最低|さいてい}でも - at the very least
・どんなに{少|すく}なくても - however little

CONTRAST:
・{少|すく}なくとも - at least (minimum bound)
・{多|おお}くても - at most (maximum bound)
